texts.zh:
一位因其不知疲倦的工作态度而在全星系备受赞誉的杰出领袖，被揭露其实不是一个人，而是两个人。

事实表明，这位领袖获得了一个完美克隆体，让两人能够轮班工作。当一个克隆体在执行公务和处理行政事务时，另一个则在秘密休息和恢复。

这一揭露在政治领域掀起了轩然大波，引发了人们对领导力本质和克隆技术伦理界限的质疑。
texts.en:
A prominent leader, celebrated galaxy-wide for their tireless work ethic, has been revealed to be not one, but two individuals.

It has come to light that this leader obtained a perfect clone, allowing each to work in alternating shifts. While one clone engaged in public duties and administrative toil, the other would rest and recuperate in secrecy.

This revelation has sent shockwaves through the political landscape, calling into question the true nature of leadership and the ethical boundaries of cloning technology.

label.zh: 这是克隆技术的高效运用。
因欺骗行为将两人一并革职。
label.en: Dismiss them both for their deceit.
